headline_check: {count} postings are waiting to be checked
headline_fresh_start: A fresh start. Which posting caught your eye first?
headline_caught_up: You’re all caught up. Found something new?
dashboard_card_applications_none_detail: Press “Want to apply” on a posting that fits, and follow it here.
dashboard_card_criteria_none_detail: Say what matters to you, so postings can be checked against it.
dashboard_card_engine_claude: Reads and checks every posting you add, with a reason for each mark.
dashboard_card_engine_ollama: Reads and checks every posting you add, on this computer only.
dashboard_card_engine_none: You check postings yourself; an AI engine can do it for you.
demand_too_few: Shows once you’ve added {min} postings with text. You have {count}.
demand_none: No skill from Merit’s list, or yours, is named in more than one of your postings yet.
demand_none_tools: No tool from Merit’s list, or yours, is named in more than one of your postings yet.
trends_insights_none: Nothing stood out that most design jobs wouldn’t ask too. Check again once you’ve added more postings.
trends_skills_legend: On your list in About you
trends_ai_intro: Check with AI to have the {count} postings read together for insights: only what most design jobs don’t ask, tied to your experience and to where you put each posting.
trends_reading: Checking {count} postings… this can take a minute.
trends_outdated: Your postings or About you changed since.
trends_no_engine: An AI engine can read your postings together and say what repeats.
need_offer: An offer for “{title}”: decide and answer
need_follow_up: No reply from “{title}” for {days} days: a short follow-up can help
copy_failed: Couldn’t copy: select the text and copy it yourself.
letter_text: Written only when you ask, on why this role fits what you care about, not a generic template. Fill in the parts in [BRACKETS] and change anything you like: it saves by itself.
letter_rewrite_changed: Redraft: the posting, your criteria or About you changed
letter_rewriting: Rewriting… this can take a minute
letter_drafting: Drafting… this can take a minute
letter_no_engine: An AI engine drafts the letter for you.
letter_needs_text: The posting has no text yet to write from: add it above.
letter_error_write: The letter couldn’t be saved. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
question_no_outsourcing: Would I be employed by you directly, or placed with one of your clients?
question_rating: How do people describe working here? Could I talk to someone on the team?
question_industries: Which industries and clients would I be working for?
question_company_size: How big is the company, and the product and design team?
question_direct_hire: Is this role with your company directly, or through an agency?
question_location: Where would I work: remote, hybrid or at the office? How many days in the office?
question_flexible_hours: How are working hours organized? Can I shape my own schedule?
question_no_shifts: Are there evening, weekend or on-call duties?
question_salary: What is the salary range for this role?
question_user_access: How often do designers talk directly with the people who use the product?
question_design_system: Do you have a design system, and how is it maintained?
question_design_maturity: Where does design sit when product decisions are made? Who does the design team report to?
applications_move_failed: That change couldn’t be saved. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
close_text: “{title}” moves to Closed. You can reopen it later.
undo_failed: That couldn’t be undone. Try again.
setup_save_failed: This step couldn’t be saved. Try again.
setup_criteria_more: The rest are in Criteria, whenever you want.
setup_skills_title: Tell us a few of your skills
setup_picks_more: The rest are in Settings, whenever you want.
setup_ai_claude_title: Claude Code is on this computer
setup_ai_none_text: You can check postings yourself, or install one and come back:
setup_ai_claude_text: reads postings best; needs a paid Claude plan
setup_ai_compare: AI engine, in Settings, compares them: what each costs, needs and does.
setup_point_criteria: Tell Merit what a good job looks like for you
setup_point_paste: Paste in the postings you find
setup_point_fit: See how each one fits, and why
setup_point_grow: Grow along the way: see what to work on next
welcome_title: Find the jobs worth your time
settings_lead: Merit and everything you put in it stay on this computer. No account, no tracking. You choose which AI helps, if any.
settings_engine_text: An AI can read each posting for you and say how well it matches what you’re looking for, and why. You can always change its answer.
settings_claude_missing: Not found on this computer. Install it, then reload this page.
settings_ollama_not_running: Not running, or not installed. Start or install it, then reload this page.
compare_check: Matches each posting against what you’re looking for
compare_screenshots: Reads a posting from a screenshot
compare_trends: Suggests what to work on, from all your postings
compare_skills: Counts the skills and tools postings ask for
compare_data: Where your postings, experience and skills are read
compare_limits_ollama: Your computer’s speed: an older one can be very slow
compare_limits_none: All by hand: you read and mark every posting, and get no suggestions
ollama_setup_failed: The download stopped. Check that Ollama is still running.
settings_ollama_model_hint: Use a chat model, not an embedding one. To read screenshots it must handle images (gemma3, qwen2.5vl, llava).
settings_error_invalid: That choice couldn’t be read. Reload the page and try again.
settings_error_no_model: Choose which Ollama model to use.
settings_error_write: The settings couldn’t be saved. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
postings_no_engine_title: Checking is done by hand for now
postings_no_engine_text: Connect an AI engine and every posting you add is checked against your criteria for you.
add_checking: Adding and checking… this can take a minute
check_no_engine: Connect an AI engine to have this posting checked for you.
check_running_hint: {engine} is reading the posting. This can take a minute.
check_error_no_criteria: there are no criteria to check yet.
check_error_nothing: there is no text or screenshot to read.
check_error_not_installed: the AI engine couldn’t be started. Check that it’s installed, in Settings.
check_error_not_running: Ollama isn’t running. Start it and try again.
check_error_no_model: the Ollama model isn’t there. Choose another one in Settings.
check_error_timeout: the AI engine took too long. Try again.
check_error_bad_answer: the AI engine’s answer couldn’t be read. Try again.
check_error_failed: the AI engine stopped with an error. Try again; if it keeps happening, check it in Settings.
postings_archive_failed: That couldn’t be saved. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
postings_search_empty_text: No posting matches “{query}”. Try another word.
postings_empty_considering_text: Postings you add land here and stay until you apply, close them or set them aside.
add_check_switch: Check each one with AI as I add it
added_note_link_unread: Link saved, but its page couldn’t be read: open it to paste the text
postings_no_criteria_text: Postings can be saved now; checking them needs at least one criterion.
fit_no_criteria_text: Set the criteria that matter to you; then you can check this posting against them.
fit_save_failed: That change couldn’t be saved. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
fit_missing_unmarked: Not checked yet: {count} of your criteria. Check again to add them.
fit_missing_out_of_date: Checked before Merit read the facts: Where you work, Salary, Industries, Company size and Rating may be out of date. Check again to update them.
postings_empty_text: Add the first posting you found, and it shows up here.
add_field_content: Paste a text, link or image
add_detected_link: A link: Merit will try to read its page.
add_detected_image: A screenshot: kept with the posting.
add_error_empty: Paste the posting’s text, a link or a screenshot first.
add_error_text_too_long: This text is longer than a posting usually is. Paste one posting at a time.
add_error_image_too_big: This image is over 10 MB. Try a smaller screenshot.
add_error_image_type: This file isn’t an image Merit can keep. Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF.
add_error_write: The posting couldn’t be saved. Check that the data folder exists and can be written to, then try again.
posting_no_text_link: Only the link is saved. Open the posting to paste its text.
add_text_reason_link: Merit couldn’t read this link’s page; the site may need you to sign in. Open the original, copy its text and paste it here.
add_text_reason_image: Merit can’t read text in a screenshot yet; that comes with an AI engine. Until then, you can paste the text here.
add_text_error: Paste the text first (up to 50,000 characters).
posting_not_found: This posting isn’t here any more. It may have been deleted.
posting_delete_text: “{title}” and its full text are removed from this computer. This can’t be undone.
posting_delete_failed: The posting couldn’t be deleted. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
criteria_title: What does a good job look like for you?
criteria_lead: Pick what Merit should check. A posting that misses a {mustHave} criterion goes to {notSure}. Everything else goes to Considering. Move any posting if you disagree.
criteria_unreadable_title: Your saved criteria couldn't be read
criteria_unreadable_text: You're seeing the defaults. When you save, the old file is kept next to the new one, so nothing is lost.
criteria_search_empty_text: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try another word, or clear the search to go back to your step.
steps_in_use_none: You have no criteria set yet
step_review_text: Your whole set at a glance.
criteria_error_invalid: The changes couldn't be read. Reload the page and try again.
criteria_error_write: Your criteria couldn't be saved. Check that the data folder exists and can be written to, then try again.
criteria_error_offline: Merit isn’t answering. Check that it’s still running, then try again.
summary_hint: Select a criterion to change it, or remove the ones you no longer want.
summary_empty_text: Set a criterion to Nice to have or Required and it shows up here.
summary_filtered_note: Nothing is deleted on its own. A posting that misses a required criterion goes to Not sure, with the reason, and you can consider it anyway.
crit_no_outsourcing_title: Not an outsourcing or placement company
crit_no_outsourcing_desc: You work for the company itself, not placed at one of its clients.
crit_rating_desc: From public reviews of the company.
crit_industries_desc: Postings in these industries count as a miss.
crit_company_size_desc: By headcount: tick the sizes that suit you.
crit_direct_hire_title: Hiring directly, not through a recruiter
crit_direct_hire_desc: The posting comes from the company itself.
crit_location_desc: You decide later what you would trade for it.
crit_flexible_hours_desc: You can shape your own schedule.
crit_no_shifts_desc: No evening, weekend or standby duty.
crit_salary_desc: Often missing. A posting without a salary, or with one in another currency or gross instead of net, passes and gets flagged, so you can ask early.
fact_rating: The posting states a rating of {rating}.
crit_user_access_title: Direct access to the people you design for
crit_design_system_desc: An existing one, or building one.
notes_dialog_text: What you heard back, kept with this posting. Only you see this.
feedback_guide_why: Few people ask, so a reply tells you what to change next time.
feedback_guide_take: Take it as notes on one application, not on you, and look for what repeats.
feedback_guide_merit: Merit reads it with your postings for Insights for you.
notes_ask_text: A short, polite message for the recruiter, from the role, the company and how it ended. Change it as you like, then copy it into your email.
notes_failed: That couldn’t be saved or drafted. Check that the data folder can be written to, then try again.
request_template_not_selected:
Hello,

Thank you for considering me for the {role} role, and for letting me know your decision. I’d be grateful for any feedback on my application or my portfolio: what stood out, and what would have made it stronger. It would help me a great deal.

Thank you for your time,
[YOUR NAME]
request_template_no_reply:
Hello,

I applied for the {role} role a while ago and wanted to follow up. Is my application still being considered? If it has been closed, I’d be grateful for any short feedback on it: what would have made it stronger.

Thank you for your time,
[YOUR NAME]
postings_not_sure_hint: Postings that miss a required criterion, and the ones you moved here yourself. Nothing is deleted: bring one back when you change your mind.
postings_empty_not_sure_text: A posting lands here when it misses one of your required criteria, or when you move it here yourself.
postings_empty_applying_text: Open a posting worth a look and press “Want to apply”: it shows up here, so you can follow it.
postings_empty_closed_text: When an application ends, mark it as closed: it moves here, with room for feedback and notes.
crit_own_product_desc: Not an agency or studio designing for clients.
crit_commute_desc: For the days in the office: it is in or near a place you name.
crit_contract_type_desc: Tick the kinds you would take. A posting offering only another kind is a miss.
crit_contract_duration_desc: Tick the ones you would take. A posting offering only the other is a miss.
crit_working_hours_desc: Tick the ones you would take. A posting offering only the other is a miss.
crit_bonus_equity_desc: Something on top of the salary.
crit_paid_time_off_desc: At least as many days off a year as you set, public holidays not counted.
crit_paid_time_off_summary: At least {value} days off a year
crit_seniority_desc: Tick the levels you would take. A posting at another level is a miss.
crit_role_type_desc: Tick what you would take: designing yourself, managing people, or both.
crit_end_to_end_desc: You work on the whole thing, from research to what ships, not one slice of it.
crit_clear_scope_desc: One product or team, not “design everything”.
crit_no_extras_desc: No front-end, graphic design or marketing expected on the side.
crit_little_travel_desc: The role doesn’t send you on regular trips away from home.
crit_mission_desc: The company works in one of the industries you tick.
crit_accessibility_desc: Designing for people with disabilities is part of the work.
crit_parental_leave_desc: More than the legal minimum, for every parent.
question_own_product: Do you design your own product, or work for clients?
question_commute: Where is the office, and how many days a week are you there?
question_contract_type: Is this an employment contract, or freelance?
question_contract_duration: Is the role permanent or fixed-term?
question_working_hours: Is it full-time, or is part-time possible?
question_seniority: What level is the role at?
question_role_type: Would I design myself, manage people, or both?
question_bonus_equity: Is there a bonus or equity on top of the salary?
question_paid_time_off: How many days off a year come with the role?
question_end_to_end: How much of the work would I own, from research to release?
question_clear_scope: Which product or team would I design for?
question_no_extras: Is there anything besides design in the role: front-end, graphics, marketing?
question_little_travel: How much travel does the role involve?
question_other_designers: How many designers are on the team, and is there someone more senior to learn from?
question_close_to_dev: How do designers work with developers and product day to day?
question_discovery_time: How much time is there for discovery before delivery?
question_outcomes_measured: How do you know whether a design worked?
question_reasonable_workload: What does a usual week look like, and how often is there overtime?
question_feedback_culture: How do designers give and get feedback?
question_low_turnover: How long have the people on the team been there?
question_inclusive: What does the team do to stay inclusive?
question_career_path: What does growth look like from this role?
question_learning_budget: Is there a budget for courses or conferences?
question_mission: What field does the company work in, and why?
question_ethical_design: How do you decide what not to build?
question_accessibility: How is accessibility part of the design work?
question_time_off_respected: Are people expected to answer after hours or on holiday?
question_parental_leave: What parental leave do you offer?
question_mental_health: What support is there for mental health?
profile_lead: What you bring and what you want to ask: Merit uses it for your cover letters, to show how your skills meet a posting, and to list your interview questions. It stays on your computer.
profile_experience_text: In your own words: roles, projects you are proud of, what you are good at. The cover letter draws on it instead of leaving [A RELEVANT PROJECT] for you to fill in.
profile_skills_text: What you know how to do: methods, fields, code. Each posting shows which of them it asks for, and what it asks that isn’t on your list.
profile_tools_text: The programs you work in: Figma, Miro, Jira… Kept apart from your skills, so a tool never pushes a skill out of what your postings ask for most.
fit_bars_skills_none_named: It names none of your skills or Merit’s
fit_bars_skills_none_yours: Add your skills in About you to see this
skills_fit_none: Add your skills to see which ones this posting asks for.
skills_fit_nothing_named: The posting doesn’t name any of your skills, or any from Merit’s list.
skills_fit_not_listed: It asks, not on your list · {count}
skills_fit_not_listed_text: If you have one of these, add it in About you.
interview_notes_hint: Either research you did about the company, or answers you got in the interview.
profile_interview_text: What a posting rarely says, so you ask. Every posting lists the questions you tick, ready to copy before a call.
ollama_setup_stopped: Download stopped at {done} of {total} GB. Continue whenever you like; nothing downloads until then.
ollama_dialog_text: Ollama will download gemma3, Google’s model, onto this computer: 3.4 GB. It can take a while; you can keep using Merit meanwhile.
ollama_delete_text: It frees {size} GB on this computer. Ollama itself stays installed, and you can download its AI again anytime.
ollama_delete_failed: It couldn’t be deleted. Quit Ollama, then try again.
